title: Natural transformations through exact derived and single comparisons
statement: For abelian categories A and B with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], exact additive functors F,G:A to B and a natural transformation tau:F to G, localizing the termwise transformation gives a shift-compatible transformation between their exact derived functors. On a complex it is the termwise localized map conjugated by the factorization comparisons. For every object M and integer r, its component on single(M)[r], followed by G shift and single comparisons, equals the F comparisons followed by single(tau_M)[r].

source.place: Steps (2) and (3), the common two-term resolution and its (ell,1) transition.

proof.text: Lift the termwise transformation through the localization at quasi-isomorphisms. The localization component formula gives its stated value on Q(P).

After precomposition with Q, this lift is the composition of the exact-functor factorization comparisons with the termwise map. Each commutes with shifts. Essential surjectivity of Q transfers this compatibility to the derived transformation.

On degree-zero singles, cancel the factorization comparison and use the existing mapDerivedCategoryFactors_inv_app_mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor_hom_app identity. The termwise square follows from naturality of tau on the self-degree single comparison, while every other degree is zero. Localize this square and compose it with shift compatibility.

proof_origin.place: Steps (2) and (3), the common two-term resolution and its (ell,1) transition.

theorem exactDerivedTransformation_shiftedSingle (τ : F ⟶ G) (M : A) (r : ℤ) :
    (exactDerivedTransformation τ).app
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj M)⟦r⟧) ≫
      (G.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso r).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj M) ≫
      ((G.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app M)⟦r⟧' =
    (F.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso r).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj M) ≫
      ((F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app M)⟦r⟧' ≫
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor B 0).map (τ.app M))⟦r⟧'
